blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Two brothers were arrested in Borbon town for robbing a house and taking nearly half a million pesos worth of cash and jewelry in Sitio Pilapilan, Caputatan, Barangay Guinacot, Danao City, Cebu. The incident took place on Monday afternoon, November 16, 2026, while the suspects were arrested during a hot pursuit operation in Sitio Saling-it, Brgy. Bongdo, Borbon town, on Tuesday evening, November 17, 2026.
